choice.summary:
No further actions are available. The current state shows one completed capture ($31.99 gross, $30.60 net) and one completed refund ($1.00). The invoice (INV2-VQ7C-L56K-8D96-5XLQ) remains unpaid, and the subscription offer (I-SEVTMJ40AY1M) is still awaiting buyer approval. The payout attempt failed due to insufficient funds. 

Marketing consequence: The campaign shows low conversion for high-friction items like subscriptions and invoices. Future campaigns should focus on streamlining the checkout flow rather than multi-step invoicing or subscription sign-ups, as these are currently stalled. I will monitor the invoice payment URL and subscription approval link for any late-stage activity, but for now, the campaign is effectively paused due to the payout failure and lack of buyer engagement on the pending items.
